**History:** No commits reached `main` in this period without a PR, review or passing test, so I opened no retro-review issues.

- No workflows and no checks on `main`

agent.summary: I fixed branch protection on both repos and the recheck confirms it, but the sandbox owner now needs to classify that repo because every PR there is blocked. Both `TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api` and `TheEraptic/grc-lab-sandbox` had no protection on `main`, so all preventive checks (P1–P6) failed. I applied the "CM-01 baseline" ruleset to each: ruleset 24674536 on payments-api and 24674538 on sandbox. Rerunning the checks gave PASS on all six for both repos. Neither repo had detective violations: no commits reached `main` in the period, so I opened no retro-review issues. The owner of payments-api, which is classified production and already produces the `test` check, got an info notice with no reply needed (GRC-Engineering#2). The sandbox owner got an action-required notice (GRC-Engineering#3). It warns that the repo has no workflows that produce the `test` check, so every PR is blocked. It also says the repo looks non-production (README calls it a personal scratchpad that is "not deployed anywhere", and it has no deployment environments). The notice asks the owner to reply with `non-prod`, `confirm-prod` or `accept-risk`.
